upcoming.title: 18th NADA Auto Show 2026 — The Golden Jubilee Edition
upcoming.excerpt: NADA's 50th-anniversary show takes over Bhrikutimandap for six days with 200+ stalls, 23 passenger-vehicle brands, and a new International Business Pavilion.
body: Nepal Automobiles Dealers' Association marks its 50th anniversary with the 18th NADA Auto Show, running six days at the Bhrikutimandap Exhibition Hall from August 25–30, 2026.

Organisers expect around 200,000 visitors across the show, with more than 200 stalls covering passenger vehicles from 23 brands, light commercial vehicles from 17 brands, two-wheelers from 13 brands, and financing or insurance desks from 10 providers.

This Golden Jubilee edition also introduces a new International Business Pavilion, giving overseas companies a dedicated space to connect with Nepali dealers and government stakeholders. Tickets are sold online through Khalti.

upcoming.title: EVTECH Nepal Expo 2026
upcoming.excerpt: A dedicated EV and battery-technology expo bringing manufacturers, charging-infrastructure companies, and policymakers together at Bhrikutimandap.
body: EVTECH Nepal Expo 2026 runs November 26–28 at the Bhrikutimandap Exhibition Hall, focused specifically on electric mobility rather than the general vehicle lineup of Nepal's bigger auto shows.

The expo is built for EV manufacturers, battery-technology suppliers, and charging-infrastructure companies to showcase their latest products alongside policymakers and investors exploring Nepal's EV market.
Full exhibitor lists and visitor timings had not been published at the time of writing — check back closer to the date for confirmed details.

past.title: NAIMA Nepal Mobility Expo 2026
past.excerpt: A six-day mobility expo at Bhrikutimandap featuring 55+ brands, 51 stalls, and over 40 new vehicle launches — visitor numbers passed 150,000 by day five.
body: NAIMA's second Nepal Mobility Expo ran six days at Bhrikutimandap from August 11–16, 2026, with 51 stalls hosting more than 55 automobile and mobility brands.
Organisers reported over 40 new vehicle and product launches during the show, and visitor numbers passed 150,000 by the fifth day — ahead of the organisers' own targets.
The expo positioned itself around a broader "mobility ecosystem" theme, covering EVs, hybrids, two-wheelers, and charging infrastructure rather than passenger cars alone.

past.title: Chitwan Auto Show 2026
past.excerpt: Bharatpur's regional auto show ran five days with 75 stalls of cars, jeeps, motorcycles and scooters, reportedly closing over NPR 1 billion in business.
body: The Chitwan Automobile Dealers Association and Chitwan Automobiles Association jointly ran this year's Chitwan Auto Show from April 30 to May 4 at the Chitwan Exhibition Centre in Bharatpur.
The five-day show hosted 75 stalls covering cars, jeeps, motorcycles, and scooters for the Chitwan and wider Terai market.
Local coverage reported over NPR 1 billion in show-period transactions, making it one of the larger regional auto shows outside the Kathmandu Valley.

past.title: NADA Presents WADA Auto Show 2026
past.excerpt: The second edition of Pokhara's own NADA-backed auto show ran at Lakeside, alongside a vintage car and robotics display.
body: NADA's western-region show, WADA Auto Show, returned to Pokhara for its second edition from March 25–29, 2026, at a dedicated ground near Talbarahi Chowk, Lakeside.
The show covered small, medium, and heavy vehicles alongside tyres, batteries, lubricants, and components from regional dealers.
Organisers paired the vehicle lineup with a vintage car display and a robotics showcase as an added draw for Pokhara's festival-season foot traffic.
